integrity: The all-order statement is supplied by a self-contained proof. Two separate literal-update exhaustive programs check all 243 and 19683 small-order states; the finite checks are not substituted for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Global extinction is proved for every admissible Paley order at least thirteen, with no uniform time bound; finite exact basin/entry counts cover only the exceptional orders five and nine. Historical priority is not established conclusively.
title: Critical-contact extinction on Paley graphs, with two exceptional wave orders
